Dana, the figure is 261 seats. Ilse posted that in #north-team on Oct 14 as the seat count for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal.

I haven't found a signed renewal document that confirms it. The only source I have is Ilse's message, so it's worth checking with Ilse or June before you lock it into the tracker. For context, the last confirmed number was 185 seats under Amendment No. 1 in August 2025. You'd first posted 180, then corrected it to 185.

I've posted the same answer in your thread in #north-team.
